verdict.rationale: Fathom documents a public REST API authenticated with API keys and available on all plans. Its reference covers listing meetings with filters, fetching transcripts and summaries, requesting downloads, listing users, teams and team members, and creating or deleting webhooks. It also ships official TypeScript and Python SDKs with auto-retry on rate limits, OAuth for public apps, and an llms.txt index. The documented surface is mostly read-oriented, and a probe found no OpenAPI spec at standard paths. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, write/control endpoints for driving the product beyond reading meeting data and managing webhooks, and a publicly reachable OpenAPI spec.
